task: Before planning, read EXPERIMENT_CONTEXT.md completely and treat it as mandatory campaign memory. Use the full 16-direction budget unless correctness or infrastructure truly blocks progress; a failed correctness gate closes only that candidate family, not the campaign. This is a focused native-HIP gfx1201 campaign whose immutable denominator is the live vLLM Triton block-scaled FP8 GEMM. Replace the candidate route with one native HIP device kernel covering every manifest case. Do not optimize or ship Triton, import FlyDSL, use AITER/CK/rocBLAS/hipBLASLt, call another library GEMM, or dispatch auxiliary kernels. Preserve exact FP32-per-K128 scaled-partial accumulation, BF16 output, arbitrary padded B row stride, fresh outputs, current-input behavior, graph safety, and one device dispatch per run. Do not use exact M/signature/model routing, weight preshuffle, persistent weight copies, activation/output memoization, or changes outside kernel_src. The only scored case is M=256,N=8192,K=5120 with B stride 5376; six zero-weight hard gates cover M240--272, M tails, contiguous/padded B, and another N/K family. Require five-draw live parity at rtol=0.02 and atol=0.0625 plus output independence. Start from a correct 128-thread BM64xBN128xBK128 wave32 WMMA design with cooperative wide global-to-LDS loads and operand reuse, then compare single/two-stage pipelines, geometry, LDS padding, load mapping, prefetch, accumulator/store layout, scale overlap, and WGP fill. Bank only reproducible gains of at least 0.5%, keep every gate at least 0.98x, and target greater than 1.01x primary speedup. For each serious candidate prove HIP source rebuild and HIP dispatch engagement, inspect ISA for v_wmma rather than emulated FP8 math, and record VGPR/SGPR/LDS/scratch. Before final promotion run paired order-reversed timing, a cache-flushed control, graph replay, and trace/ISA/resource checks.

op_spec.implementation: single-dispatch native HIP gfx1201 WMMA raw-weight block-scaled FP8 GEMM
op_spec.layout_contract: A[M,K] and A_scale[M,K/128] are contiguous. B is logical [N,K] with stride(1)=1 and either arbitrary padded or contiguous stride(0). B_scale[N/128,K/128] is contiguous.
op_spec.math_contract: For each K128 block, complete the FP8 dot in FP32, multiply its independent FP32 A/B scales, accumulate scaled blocks in FP32, and cast once to BF16.
op_spec.routing_contract: One explainable native-HIP family must cover M240--272 and both manifest N/K families. Never route by an exact M, captured signature, or model identity.
